```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

This stores the key in your `.Renviron` file so every future R session finds it automatically. The key is stored on this machine only—on a new machine, install it again with `census_api_key("KEY", install = TRUE, overwrite = TRUE)`. In other words, if you install the key in a Codespace, it disappears when the Codespace does. You will need to do it again when you start a new Codespace, at least until you learn how to create a dotfiles repo.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(income_tx) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Median household income (USD)",
                       labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
  coord_sf(datum = NA) +
  labs(
    title = "2020 Median Household Income by Texas County",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2016-2020 American Community Survey 5-year estimates."
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
  )
```
